video_title: The Food Nanny x Minky Couture collaboration announcement
evidence: Creator-side Instagram evidence from The Food Nanny on August 16, 2026 says that partnering with @minkycouture feels like a natural dream and promotes their jointly developed Minky Couture collection ahead of its August 20 launch. Minky Couture's current marketing feed confirms MINKY COUTURE X FOOD NANNY became official on August 20, 2026 and separately states on August 7 that it was currently partnering with influencers. Minky Couture's official FAQ explicitly instructs sponsorship inquiries to sponsorships@minkycouture.com and social-media collaborations to collaborations@minkycouture.com.
